title: radiation.subskill_card/1 — Subskill Catalog + Hook Protocol + Verify Policy (WP-1 1.5)
description: Typed record for subskills present in-tree, with FK to SKILL_CATALOG and hook trigger contract. P-18 G4: subskills become typed records; hooks declared, machine-checked, never autonomous. WP-1 1.5: additive optional verify policy field on every subskill, namespaced extension tolerating unknown keys, existing linters must not redden. Router honors required/opt-in/opt-out per 1.5. MEM-shrine-log is a deliberate outer-corpus pointer (docs/shrine/LOG.md); all other catalog paths MUST live under Brain/ or subskills/.

parent_skill.description: FK to SKILL_CATALOG id, must resolve against skills/SKILL_CATALOG.json

entry_path.description: existing subskill entry path relative to repo root, must exist

trigger.description: hook trigger — hook means INVOKED, never self-firing autonomous

condition.description: condition for hook firing, null if unconditional

scenario_ref.description: path to scenario fixture proving hook contract, must resolve

status.description: active=has scenario, declared=needs note, deprecated=needs superseded_by

note.description: optional note, required if status declared

superseded_by.description: required if status deprecated, id of subskill that supersedes

verify.description: WP-1 1.5 — additive optional verify policy field on every subskill, namespaced extension tolerating unknown keys, existing linters must not redden — router honors required/opt-in/opt-out per 1.5 — no behavioral grading format and deterministic checks only

policy.description: verification policy class — required/opt-in/opt-out per 1.5, raise-only ratchet note

checks.description: deterministic checks for this policy class — format and deterministic checks only per 1.5, no behavioral grading

seed.description: WP-2.3 cassette seed name this trace registers as per J1 rule of travel build neither twice
